reason: "The Period of performance (Deliveries) should not exceed 100 days." Cap on this purchase order; 100 days.
"extend the current contract ... by up to 11.5 months"; 11.5 x 30 = 345.
"by 6 months from 11 February 2026 to 11 August 2026" / "A six-month bridge contract action": a plain stated period. The context has no limit wording (no not-to-exceed, up to, or limited to).
"The proposed bridge action is limited to one-month"; 30 days.
"The totality of the contract extension will not exceed six months." 180.
"Period of Performance shall be no longer than 120 days." (SOW for this sole-source project).
"Authority to act under this CJ&A expires five years from the date of BOA execution, or 15 July 2027": this is when the class J&A's authority expires, not a cap on a period of performance.
"allow for up to a twelve (12) month extension"; 365.

"deliver and complete all requirements of this Statement of Work no later than 6 weeks after contract award": this is a delivery and completion deadline, not worded as a period-of-performance limit. It works as a 6-week cap (42 days), so readers could disagree.
"initially be extended six (6) months but may be extended up to an additional six (6) months for a total of twelve (12) months"; a cap on this extension of 12 x 30 = 360.

"one-year base period with four one-year option periods. The contract will also include up to a six-month period under the authority of FAR 52.217-8": the six-month cap applies to the 52.217-8 extension option, not to this 5-year contract.
"The estimated period of performance is up to four months." (this sole-source extension); 120.

"Option to Extend Services per FAR Clause 52.217-8 up to 6 months": the cap applies to the 52.217-8 option of a new contract with a 12-month base plus four 12-month options, not to the action's period of performance.
"extend the services on the current contract for up to one year" via the new task order; 365.
"bridge TO is limited to a single 12-month order period"; 365.

"extend the period of performance ... through August 5, 2026, and for up to six (6) months thereafter": the 'up to six months' applies only to the second segment. The text describes an "initial six-month extension" plus a "six-month extension thereafter", so 180 is not the cap on the whole action.
"bridge of continuity ... for a period of up to 24 months" (12-month base plus two 6-month options); 730.
"five one-year ordering periods and an Option to Extend Services for no more than 6 months via RFO 52.217-8": the cap applies to the 52.217-8 option of a 5-year IDIQ, not to the action's period.

"in no case will any of those subsumable contracts exceed the ten-year period authorized by 10 U.S.C. 2304a(f), unless appropriate approval is obtained": a statutory limit on future subsumable contracts (the overarching terms run 20 years), not a cap on this action.
"extended under this contract for the necessary length of time required, but not to exceed six (6) months"; 180.
"The total duration of the contract shall not exceed five (5) years." 5 x 365 = 1825.
"extend the ordering period for up to two (2) months": this action's extension; 60.
"The contract will be executed in a timely manner ... but not more than 180 days."
"for up to one (1) year of contract performance" for the CCN Region 3 extension; 365.
"extending the period of performance of this TO up to six (6) months" (this modification); 180.
"three-month base period and one three-month option period, not to exceed six months in total"; 180.
"EEOC will determine if these services are required past a 36-month period": a statement about future competition, not limit wording on this action's period of performance.

"The length of this SSJ will be for 18 months from the date of the Presidential Disaster Declaration, in accordance with HSAR 3006.302-1(b)(4)": a regulatory duration for the J&A that runs from the declaration date, not a cap on the action's period (base 3 months plus five 3-month extensions).

"Period of Performance (PoP) from October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2030. This task order will have FAR 52.217-8 ... not to exceed six (6) months": the cap applies to the 52.217-8 option, not to this 4-year task order.

GSA Class justification CD-2021-02 (2021): "This class justification is limited to lease acquisitions— a. with a total period of performance no longer than one (1) year, unless exceptional circumstances exist": a general class-wide limit with an exception, not specific to the Wichita lease.
